Name: Customize Exterior
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Customize the exterior of your buildings individually.
Description:
**This mod is deprecated.**
It's compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4 and 1.5.5, but may not be updated for future versions. Consider using [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) instead.

----------------------------------------------------------

**Customize Exterior** lets you customize the exterior of your buildings individually. This lets you have a different texture for each instance of a building.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) and [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
**Adding textures**
This mod has no built-in custom textures; you need to download the textures you want to use.

Customize Exterior will create a [font=Courier New]Buildings[/font] subfolder the first time you run it. You can install any number of texture sets by putting each one in its own subfolder of [font=Courier New]Buildings[/font]. The name of each file should match the building in your game's [font=Courier New]Content/Buildings[/font] folder. Each texture can be a [font=Courier New].png[/font] or [font=Courier New].xnb[/font] file.

**Applying textures in-game**
Double right-click a building in-game to show the texture selection UI, and choose the texture to apply.

**Textures in screenshot**
For the texture sets shown in the screenshot, see:

*   [Birch Building Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/583)

*   <s>[Medieval Modern Buildings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419)</s>

*   [Seasonal Vanilla](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/928)

*   <s>[Victorian Era Buildings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/682)</s>

*   <s>[Seasonal Victorian Buildings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891)</s>
**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
